title: Greece Study Visa Pakistan — Requirements, Fees, IELTS & FAQ | SK Immigration
description: Greece study visa from Pakistan (Schengen / EU): requirements, documents, fees, IELTS, low marks, timeline and FAQ. SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: What are Greece study visa requirements from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Admission letter; Proof of funds; Insurance; Passport, forms, photos. SK Immigration builds a full checklist for your case.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to study in Greece from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Budget tuition + living + visa/insurance. Greece is generally more affordable than UK/Canada for many programmes. SK packages from PKR 50,000 cover preparation only — not tuition.

faqs.question: Do I need IELTS for Greece study visa?
faqs.answer: English programmes usually need IELTS or university English proof.

faqs.question: Can I study in Greece with low marks?
faqs.answer: Varies widely by institution — we shortlist realistically.

faqs.question: How long does Greece student visa take from Pakistan?
What documents are needed for Greece student visa?
faqs.answer: Passport pack; Acceptance; Bank proof; Insurance; Academics; Housing.

faqs.question: Can I work while studying in Greece?
faqs.answer: Student work limits apply — verify residence conditions.

faqs.question: How to apply for Greece study visa from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Secure admission, prepare funds/insurance/docs, then file the correct national/student visa. SK Immigration sequences the file; authorities decide.

faqs.question: What is SK Immigration’s fee for Greece study?
faqs.answer: Student packages from PKR 50,000 for preparation. Embassy and university fees are separate. No visa guarantees.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee Greece student visa approval?
faqs.answer: No. Embassies and immigration authorities decide. We prepare complete, honest files.
